images.filename: Brentford Play-Off Final - May 2013 - I Do Love a Silly Hat (8831864944).jpg
images.caption: The only way to get from Brentford to Wembley for a big day out is on one of London's famous Big Red Buses and the only Big Red Bus to travel on in style is the Routemaster. The Griffin Pub in Brentford arranged this 'Transport of Delight' for its regular customers so we stuck our hand out at a 'request' stop and hopped on, for all the good it did us as we lost our 6th major final in 16 years. The Oxford English Dictionary's up-dated definition of 'Long-Suffering is now 'Brentford FC Fan' sadly.
images.alt: The only way to get from Brentford to Wembley for a big day out is on one of London's famous Big Red Buses and the only Big Red Bus to travel on in style is the Routemaster. images.filename: Bristol Rovers v Tranmere Rovers, Wembley 1990 (344523653).jpg
images.caption: The Leyland Daf cup final between Bristol Rovers and Tranmere Rovers at Wembley on May 20th 1990. In this picture, Devon White has just equalised for Bristol Rovers, although Tranmere went on to win the game 2-1. Nonetheless it was a major achievement for the Pirates to reach a Wembley final and the 1989/90 season brought much greater success than any realistic Bristol Rovers fan could have dreamed of.
images.alt: The Leyland Daf cup final between Bristol Rovers and Tranmere Rovers at Wembley on May 20th 1990. In this picture, Devon White has just equalised for Bristol Rovers, although Tranmere went on to win the game 2-1.
